title: Where should study presets be saved?
context: Users want to save and share a full study setup.

options.name: In the page link
options.summary: Encode the preset in the URL.
assumptions: Setups stay under a few kilobytes
risks: Some chat apps truncate long links

options.name: Downloadable preset file
options.summary: Save a small JSON file the user can load back in.
assumptions: Users are fine dragging a file in
risks: Old files breaking after format changes

estimates.basis: save, load and a version field

recommendation: Setups with imported geometry outgrow links quickly.

evidence.claim: Imported meshes make setups far larger than a link can hold.

reason: Files match how I already hand off studies.

files.change: new: write the current study to a versioned JSON file
new: read a preset, migrate older versions, apply to the study
add save and load buttons with drawn icons

steps: Define the preset format with a version field and units stated on every length
Write save, then load with a migration hook
Round-trip test on three existing studies
done_when: Saving then loading reproduces the study exactly
A file from an older version loads with a clear message if anything changed
validation: Round-trip comparison of every setting on three studies
avoid: Storing geometry in the preset; reference the file instead
Adding a settings toggle for this
